_comment: Test-host-only configuration, loaded automatically by WebApplicationFactory (IntegrationTestFixture sets ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Testing). SigningKey below is a fixed, non-secret, CSPRNG-generated 32-byte test-only key -- safe to commit because it signs nothing outside the test process and is never valid against any real deployment's Issuer/Audience (Technical Architect required change #5, WP-4 brief review). See JwtOptions.cs remarks for the full provisioning story.

RateLimiting._comment: Generous test-only limits -- see Program.cs's rate-limiter comment. IntegrationTestFixture is one shared WebApplicationFactory for the whole 'Integration' xunit collection, so every functional test's login/refresh/forgot-password/reset-password calls compete for the same partition. RateLimitingTests.cs proves the real (production-sized) limits still work, via its own isolated host that overrides these back down.

Resend._comment: Fixed, obviously-fake, non-secret test-only value -- safe to commit because ResendEmailService is never actually constructed or called in the Testing host (IntegrationTestFixture.ConfigureWebHost substitutes CapturingEmailService before the host finishes building). This exists only to satisfy ResendOptions' mandatory ValidateOnStart() at boot. See ResendOptions.cs remarks.
